center.locator: Arithmetic mean of the 34 vertices of the RHIC ring (OSM way/50074088)
center.note: Map centre only; not a claim about any structure. precision_m is set loosely because this is a naive vertex-average centroid, not an area centroid.

levels.name: RHIC tunnel
levels.note: OpenStreetMap tags the ring tunnel=yes/indoor=yes/layer=-5, confirming it is underground; no source consulted states a metres-below-surface figure for the RHIC tunnel specifically, so the depth is left blank rather than guessed.

levels.name: AGS tunnel
levels.note: BNL's own 1960 Bulletin Board describes the AGS ring as an 'underground magnet tunnel' built in a dug 'circular trench' with a 'ring-shaped 18 foot square' cross-section (src:geo-bnl-ags-1960-bulletin), confirming it is underground; no source consulted states a metres-below-surface figure, so the depth is left blank rather than guessed.

name: Brookhaven National Laboratory — Upton campus, RHIC and AGS rings
notes: All three of this facility's Atlas sites (site:bnl-upton-campus, site:bnl-rhic-ip6-star, site:bnl-rhic-ip8-phenix-sphenix) and both of its Atlas accelerators (accelerator:rhic, accelerator:ags) are drawn; nothing is listed as not drawn. Buildings 930 (Linear Accelerator), 901 (Tandem Van de Graaff) and 942 (AGS Booster) are drawn as context features not linked to an entity, because the Atlas has no accelerator records for the linac or the Booster.

The campus boundary (geometry:bnl-upton-campus-boundary) is OSM relation 18896697, fetched through the Nominatim search API; an Overpass query for a boundary polygon (comparable to CERN's Meyrin/Prévessin fence lines) could not be completed.

E949 (Brookhaven AGS experiment, K+ -> pi+ nu nu-bar) has no Atlas site or detector record of its own (its facility roles reference facility:brookhaven-national-laboratory only), so nothing about it is drawn or listed as not drawn; a candidate location (Building 912, 'AGS Exp. Area', drawn here as geometry:bnl-ags-experimental-area-building) would be the place to start if a site record is added.

schematics.note: Official BNL campus-map inset draws RHIC as a plain circle with numbered interaction-region halls; topology and building-number key only, not geographic. Never drawn on the to-scale map (the georeferenced OSM ring is used instead).
schematics.title: Brookhaven National Laboratory campus map, North Area Facility inset (schematic RHIC ring, not to scale)

summary.plain: Brookhaven National Laboratory's main campus in Upton, New York: the 3.8-km RHIC ring with the STAR and PHENIX/sPHENIX detector halls at two of its interaction points, the older 807-m AGS ring that now injects into RHIC, and nearby accelerator buildings, drawn to scale from OpenStreetMap and BNL's own published figures.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:brookhaven-national-laboratory spanning the RHIC and AGS ring footprints and the adjoining accelerator-complex buildings on the Upton campus. Geometry sourced from OpenStreetMap (way 50074088 for the RHIC ring, tagged tunnel=yes/indoor=yes; way 289305285 for the AGS ring, tagged place=locality) cross-checked against BNL's published RHIC circumference (2.4 mi) and the AGS's 1960 design-specification mean radius (421.5 ft), plus OSM building footprints for the STAR (1006/1006A) and PHENIX/sPHENIX (1008/1008A) halls corroborated against BNL's own central-campus-map building-number key.

unlocated.backlog: A BNL AGS Booster design drawing or civil-engineering plan with a scale bar (or a survey table of the ring), georeferenced against the surveyed AGS and RHIC rings; the BNL central campus map key only labels Building 942.
unlocated.reason: The AGS Booster (Building 942) sits beside the AGS ring, but OpenStreetMap carries only a hand-labelled place=locality boundary around it (way 996525504, drawn as the context feature "AGS Booster (Building 942), approximate area") and no consulted source gives a survey or a georeferenced trace of the Booster ring itself. That area label is not drawn as the accelerator.
